notes.title: Update 2.4 - Improved performance
notes.notes: This update improves performance for older and slower systems. Improvements relate to RAM and VRAM usage as well as loading times.

notes.title: Update 2.36 - Compactor Photo Sensor and bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h2]New functionality[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now purchase an [b]automatic photo sensor for all compactor containers[/b] (SPB, MPB, APB, Shark and Midi LM). This will automatically turn on and off the compactor based on the current fill level of the hopper.
[*] The [b]message[/b] "A skip is full" will now also display the [b]container type and trash type[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that the rear gate would not open with the tow truck for some players
[*] Improved functionality of the document shredder and used clothing box to avoid trash objects getting stuck or lost in the containers
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.35 - Bugfix Container Truck Expansion and more
notes.notes:
[h1]Improvements and Bugfixes[/h1]

[h2]Base game[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Performance optimizations[/b] for debris fragments with improved framerates and shorter save times

[list]

notes.title: Update 2.3 - Scrap, the dog
notes.notes:
Get this little buddy to join you on the yard. He will stay with his bowl on the mat next to the office.

If you're ever about to make a mistake at charging fees he will save you from the consequences. 

Apart from that, he will stay quiet and spread joy.

notes.title: Update 2.22 - Bugfix Resources and Savegames
notes.notes:
Added a [b]reset function[/b] for the resource machines in the DLC [b]"Resources Trading Expansion"[/b].
In case a pallet gets stuck or lost, aim at the machine to display the current fill percentage and press [b]Delete[/b] to reset it. 

The [b]process duration[/b] for wood chip shredding was reduced.

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that caused duplicated cardboard pallets after loading a savegame
[*] Fixed a problem with the temporary save directory
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.21 - Bugfix Backpack
notes.notes: Problem of the backpack was fixed

notes.title: Update 2.2 - Bug fix for shredder
notes.notes: Enhanced physics behavior will allow shredders to destroy objects and create shards also in longer game sessions. This improvements affects the wood shredder from Resources Trading Expansion DLC as well as the two-shaft shredder from the main game.

notes.notes:

[*] Improved car's audio sources
[*] Fixed a bug with camera controls
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.12 - Bugfix Pressure Washer
notes.notes: Fixed the bug with the camera while using the power washer

notes.title: Update 2.11 - Bugfix Skip Container Truck
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with the skip container truck (Container Truck Expansion)

notes.title: Update 2.1 - The backpack, skip auto-save and more
notes.notes:
You can now purchase the [b]backpack[/b] in your Recycling Center shop. The backpack allows you to carry [b]up to 8 small trash items at once[/b]. This will make it a lot easier and quicker to take care of a customer with multiple seperate items!

There is also a new option to [b]skip the auto-save[/b] when opening the shop tab in game. Just press the key to open the shop (F on keyboard or Y on Xbox controller) again within one second after opening the shop.

Some [b]additional bugfixes and improvements[/b] include:

[list]
[*] Menu to empty containers (DLC Container Truck Expansion) can now also be triggered by controller
[*] Fixed a problem that caused trash to float in compactor containers
[*] Input icons for keyboard layout displays are scaled up slightly
[/list]

notes.title: DLC Container Truck Expansion - Update 1.2
notes.notes:
New for the DLC [b]Container Truck Expansion[/b]: Watch the fuel tank of your trucks.

Check the gauges and make sure to stop at the gas station on the way. If you run out of Diesel, the expensive emergency service has to be called.

The driving style will influence your fuel consumption.

Also includes multiple bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the crane of the skip truck could not be used after first use
[*] Yard exit lane is now also useable as an entry when returning from the skip
[/list]

notes.title: DLC Container Truck Expansion - Update 1.11
notes.notes: - Fixed a problem where the Shark compactor could not be loaded and emptied

notes.title: DLC Container Truck Expansion - Update 1.1
notes.notes:
- Added trash types Scrap Tires and Glass for disposal at the waste processing plant
- Fixed truck controller inputs
- bug fixes

notes.title: Update 2.03 - Bugfixes and logs
notes.notes:
Thanks to user feedback, several problems with the new savegames could be fixed. Also, some new log entries were added to improve debugging.

If other problems occur, please keep reporting on Community Hub and send in the log files.

notes.title: Update 2.01 - Fixed issue with cleaning containers
notes.notes: Small update that fixes a bug with container cleaning.

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Saving Container Contents
notes.notes:
Dear players,

the final weekly update brings you game version 2.0 and includes big changes behind the scenes.

A feature requested by many players has been included and required modifications to the game structure and source code.

Trash collected in the containers will now be stored together with the savegames. That way you can pile up large amounts of garbage until the container finally needs to be emptied.

Based on these changes, a fee is now applied when emptying the containers based on the container volume. 

Please check out the upcoming DLC "Container Truck Expansion" with the new trailer video: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852900/Mein_Recyclinghof__Container_Truck_Expansion/

This addon will be available soon.

Hint: Saving trash objects only works in the container's storage volume, it does not apply to the hopper of the compactors or the ground of your yard.

notes.title: Update 1.93 - New Compactor Container Midi LM, more trash items
notes.notes:
This update introduces the [b]compact, fast and well-priced Compactor Container Midi LM[/b]. It is recommended for Recyclables, Residential Trash and Organic Waste. As a skip lift container, it takes up little space and can be placed on the front slots of the yard without issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/7a898f101096e8934d7423b5fbd7173ba4645572.png[/img]

[b]24 new trash items[/b] add on to the large amount of [b]now over 600 different objects[/b]. The new objects are categorized as [b]Appliances, Electric Devices, Used Clothes, Bulk Trash and Timber[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/50d99535f7549ba63ccb842f26376054206239a6.png[/img]

Available soon: The DLC "[b]Container Truck Expansion[/b]" introduces skip and hooklift trucks and a [b]realistic waste processing plant[/b]. Load your full containers onto the trucks and take them to the dump. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852900/Mein_Recyclinghof__Container_Truck_Expansion/]Check it out and wishlist now![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/7038fe538df5b90400e62d82cb671a8af5da9941.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.92 - Trash Focus View, new Items, Fast Cleaning
notes.notes:
The [b]new trash focus view[/b] can be triggered by pressing Tab and will make it easy to [b]find and collect every trash[/b] item of your customer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/cbb5373ac7beb48c31ec018e88486f6b3998c7e7.jpg[/img]

This mode also allows you to [b]select trash through car walls [/b]and seats.

[b]Site upgrades[/b] like fences, office containers, signs and licenses [b]can now be sold[/b] and deactivated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/3b6a805c62e04a7eb831a1ae20166a57eed78c1c.png[/img]

The [b]container cleaning process can be skipped[/b] for a fee to save time. The container will get clean instantly, but you won't get any satisfaction reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/386defef096eba7f8124b0b04cc62dc1f5736dbe.png[/img]

More variety in collecting and crushing trash: [b]27 new objects[/b] for Bulk Waste, Timber, Construction Waste and Scrap Metal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/5b458c1f374222b1fec9db56027fc809aa3fb656.png[/img]

Also includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Changed controller mapping for picking up trash
[*] Changed wrong trash type of the oven to Scrap Metal
[*] Fixed blue cardboard box error
[*] Added trash focus view to tutorial
[*] Improved interior collision of car A3
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.91 - Commercial Waste Trucks, new trash items and upgrades
notes.notes:
You can now get the [b]new license for commercial waste trucks[/b] in the in-game shop. Trade customers will deliver large amounts of trash in a truck, randomly generated from one of these trash types: Bulk Waste, Timber, Cardboard, Scrap Metal, Electric Devices, Household Appliances, Scrap Tires, Residential Waste or Recyclables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/f11eeb8387728636bb30a0d6ca6141dd62e9f20c.jpg[/img]

A new upgrade for compactor containers is available: The [b]high-performance hydraulic pump[/b]. It will make your compactors faster and more quiet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/3effc729f371511f03629bfdbdcd786cd96e40aa.png[/img]

As requested by users, the document shredder now can be equipped with a [b]photo sensor[/b].

[b]32 new trash items[/b] have been added for extra variety. Trash types: TImber, Scrap Metal, Electric Devices, Residential Waste, Cardboard and Bulk Waste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/0ba6e4ad3cfd3e133c205139a5ce6e0cece7eab3.png[/img]

Also a number of small [b]improvements[/b] are included:

[list]
[*] Improved [b]physics[/b] of drum compactor
[*] Bug of container [b]fill percent display[/b] fixed
[*] [b]Easier to pick[/b] up distant trash items
[*] [b]Additional reward[/b] (satisfaction) when entry gate opened quickly
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.9 - Organic Waste, new Skip and Site Upgrades
notes.notes:
[b]Unlock the new trash type[/b] Organic Waste if you have a sufficient satisfaction level. 

Many [b]new objects have been added[/b], such as kitchen waste, used coffee filters, banana or orange peels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/ab7fbb1d577e3c33627c42b08be97b9e5e4c1c24.png[/img]

This update also includes [b]a new flat skip[/b], perfect for use with Organic Waste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/53059606403382ba309f0835be933a42391edaf2.png[/img]

Improve your daily routine in the Recycling Center with the [b]new site upgrades[/b]:

[list]
[*] Fully automatic gate that opens and closes by itself
[*] Sign "Please don't honk" to stop drivers honking at the entry
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/ba885d0c5763ff05a1e3182f50598fc01aec20d6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.8 - New Cars, Trailer and Crammed Compactors
notes.notes:
[b]3 new car models[/b] add plenty of variation to your customers. With all paint schemes together, this brings 17 new versions of cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/b3e55a0baae898ad375797453585a939869c60c2.png[/img]

The [b]new twin-axle trailer[/b] with a huge loading space brings in large piles of trash into your daily routine at the recycling center.

Another new feature: Compactor Containers will actually [b]get crammed and fill up[/b]. The warning light will light up when they get 75% percent full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/c6eb9a93004398024033e5129ccd05ddff10f3f2.png[/img]

You will notice changes in compacting force and speed when the compactor is starting to struggle.

The management page will show the current [b]fill state in percent[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/b67f862c09d42048ffb453e77b612ac6846436ee.png[/img]

[b]Additional improvements[/b] were made to the shredder and electric test station's physics.

notes.title: Update 1.7 - Document Destruction, Sell Containers and more
notes.notes:
Unlock the [b]new Document Destruction service[/b] and buy the authentic [b]industrial shredder[/b] which will eat files, folders and stacks of paper with no problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/85e2ef37d6d4e29e9ba48ccbb4a834381b29e760.jpg[/img]

Customers will pay fees for [b]reliable disposal of confidential data[/b].

[b]45 new objects[/b] were added to display files, folders and documents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/7b6dd6a3dbbb92ed84cedc36f47128c631623639.png[/img]

In addition, you are now able to [b]sell containers[/b]. The sale value will depend on the upgrades of the container, but also on how clean it is!

As requested by players, the [b]physics and controls of the barrow and cart[/b] were re-designed from scratch.

We also added a [b]progress bar[/b] when using the pressure washer and some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.61
notes.notes: [b]Hotfix[/b] for physics problem that would sometimes cause trash not to be compacted

notes.title: Update 1.6 - "Shark" Compactor Container
notes.notes:
The [b]new compactor container[/b] "Shark" is now available! A [b]large, powerful compactor[/b] perfectly suited for Bulk Trash, Timber and Waste Paper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/cbc6028a9426d8fe0a36b11daabe61894fe286f7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/c32e03d01cb6032e63fa2c3b058cbd68216b4434.jpg[/img]

Also, the [b]achievement "Full Diversity"[/b] can now be unlocked correctly. This was not possible until now because of a bug. For compensation, [b]3 additional new achievements[/b] were added.

Player's wishes have been heard: You can now purchase the [b]photosensor for the garden waste shredder[/b]. This will make the machine turn on and off automatically. 

In addition, some [b]physics improvements[/b] were made for the delivering cars.

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Used Clothes and Shoes
notes.notes:
The [b]new collecting box[/b] for used clothes and shoes is now available for your yard. [b]Unlock[/b] the new used clothing trash type with [b]37 new trash objects[/b]. Use the animated trap door on the container to discard old clothes and shoes.

The update also contains small bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Electric Device Testing Station
notes.notes:
You can now purchase the [b]Electric Device Testing Station[/b] as an [b]extension of the Second-Hand Shop[/b].

This Testing Station will be placed on any free slot on your site. When a customer brings in electric devices or appliances to discard, you can use it to quickly test the old appliances and offer them for sale if they pass the test.

Your yard will also be expanded by [b]8 additional slots[/b] to make room for [b]more free updates in the future[/b]!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] New upgrade for purchase: Electric Device Testing Station
[*] Yard is expanded by 8 additional slots
[*] Physics and trigger updates for containers to improve container emptying procedure
[*] FPS performance of the tyre shredder improved
[*] Mouse-click trigger for Garden Waste Chopper improved
[*] Modified trash spawns on trailers to avoid trash falling off
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Second Hand Shop
notes.notes:
You can now purchase the [b]second-hand shop building[/b] for your recycling center. Offer re-usable goods for sale and [b]save them from the crusher[/b]. 

The shop building also includes an [b]office for your site management[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/42747b90da4cbe083333ae2b883792ba978dbd17.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Shredder and Scrap Tires
notes.notes:
[b]More content[/b] for your yard! You can now set up a [b]maximum of 14 containers[/b]. The new 2-rotor [b]shredder[/b] will take care of the [b]new trash type Scrap Tires[/b]. Also, every item in the shop has a short [b]description[/b].
The update also includes small bug fixes and physics[b] improvements[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/98467937568303ba186b933eb6be04ae831e86bf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New trash type to unlock: Scrap Tires with 15 new objects.
[*] 2-rotor shredder with conveyor belt and purchasable upgrades
[*] 2 new container slots for expansion of your yard
[*] Shop now includes item descriptions
[*] Bug fixes for physics and objects
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/98467937568303ba186b933eb6be04ae831e86bf.png[/img]
